name: Polypropylene (gas phase, bulk)
principle: Propylene, with ethylene or other comonomers for copolymers, is polymerised over a supported Ziegler-Natta or metallocene catalyst in a gas-phase reactor or in liquid propylene (bulk loop) reactors. After the reactor the powder is degassed, mixed with additives and pelletised. Impact copolymers use a second reactor to add a rubber phase.
